news.title: Messi's legendary run for Argentina almost never happened after heartbreak
news.lede: Lionel Messi rose to the legendary status of Diego Maradona, but the road to glory started with heartbreak. (Getty Images: Anychance/Simon Bruty). Lionel Messi's retirement from the Argentina national side brings down the curtain on one of world football's most storied international careers. The records and achievements of Messi are stuff of legend, and his status in international sport is reserved for only the very greatest of their craft.

news.title: "Football loses part of its soul": world's newspapers react to the Messi bombshell
news.lede: Emotional reactions in the farewell to Argentina's legend. Lionel Messi announced his international retirement on Monday evening, and the world's sports newspapers cast it as the end of an exceptional chapter in the history of the Argentina national team and world football. Reaction to the surprise decision ranged from shock at its timing to a recalling of the numbers and titles, and to the void the former Argentina captain will leave after more than two decades in the shirt. Messi, "39 years old", broke the news in an emotional message.

news.title: Lionel Messi’s international retirement serves as a reminder: Watch him while you still can
news.lede: The Argentine’s career with Argentina was singular, and his exit is a reminder that all good things come to an end. IIt was among the defining moments of the 2026 World Cup: Lionel Messi standing arms akimbo, looking up towards Argentina’s fervent supporters after losing the final. Tears streamed down his face after his team’s embarrassing loss to Spain in what we now know was Messi’s final match wearing that famous Argentina kit. It was not the first time he’d cried at the tournament.

news.title: Argentina’s Lionel Messi retires from international football: ‘This hurts me a lot’
news.lede: Argentina great’s last game was in World Cup final. Player’s father Jorge died earlier in August. Lionel Messi has announced his retirement from international football seven weeks after Argentina were beaten by Spain in the World Cup final in the US. The 39-year-old captained Argentina to World Cup glory in 2022 and two Copa América titles after winning his first cap in 2005.
